title: Lift-off, with turbulence: India's next 161 unicorns
dek: 161 Indian startups on the runway to $1 billion: the jobs, the deep tech, the money behind them and the failures.
blurb: India now has 161 startups on the runway to $1 billion, and more of them make rockets, chips and solar modules than apps. The jobs, the government's ₹1 lakh crore RDI fund and the investors backing them, the collapses that say not all will make it, and a watchlist of 70 deep-tech startups.
cover_alt: Lift-off, with turbulence: India's next 161 unicorns. A navy-to-dusk sky over a city skyline, with the KKReckons special report kicker.

title: Wall Street to brunch: Claude's wins, on Anthropic's word. Who checked?
dek: 26 Claude use cases from Anthropic's S-1, the measured gains, and the evidence that cuts the other way.
blurb: Anthropic's IPO filing shows Claude inside 26 organisations, from AIG's underwriters to a Boston brunch kitchen. What it saved, where the gains are biggest, and what the numbers can't tell you.
cover_alt: Wall Street to brunch: Claude's wins, on Anthropic's word. Who checked? A navy-to-dusk sky over a city skyline, with the KKReckons special report kicker.

title: Popped or leaking? The AI bubble in October 2026
dek: China's AI shares have crashed while America's boom leaks through credit: neocloud debt, Gartner's $4.9tn revenue gap, history, hedges and the India angle.
cover_alt: China popped. America is leaking. A burst bubble marked China equities minus 40%, and a leaking bubble holding IOUs marked US credit 1,148bp.
